contexts.text: Those with whom there are truths, and these full of goods, are signified by fifty ().
Perchance there are fifty righteous in the midst of the city = that truths may be full of goods. Fifty = what is full. AC 2261.

The reason fifty = what is full, is that it follows seven times seven... so that it is their impletion... and therefore the feast of seven sabbaths was on the fiftieth day, and the Jubilee in the fiftieth year (), from which it is evident that fifty = what is full in relation to the sabbaths. Moreover, wherever fifty is mentioned in the Word, it = what is full; as, the Levites being numbered... up to fifty years () = a full or last state of discharging the ministry... Fifty of silver () = a full fine and full restitution... Fifty shekels of silver () = a full price, and a full purchase... Fifty men running before him ( and ) = full excellence and greatness... Write fifty () = a full release... He came to... draw fifty from the winepress, there was twenty () = that instead of being full there was not much.

Princes of fifties () = primary intermediates... Fifties = intermediates, namely, between those truths from good which are in the second degree and those which are in the third... The reason fifties = intermediates, is that by fifty is signified both much and somewhat. References. Hence, when fifty is mentioned between a hundred and ten, it = intermediates.
The dowry was fifty of silver given to the father of the girl (), thus truths initiating to a full conjunction.
Seven sabbaths were numbered up to the feast which consequently took place on the fiftieth day (; ) = the plenary implantation of truth in good even to the first of a new state.
Fifty loops shalt thou make in one curtain () = plenary conjunction in the ultimates of the spheres. Fifty = what is full. AC 9609. AC 9623.
Thou shalt make fifty little handles of gold () = plenary capacity of conjunction from good. Fifty = what is plenary. AC 9624.
The hangings of fifty cubits () truths as much as is sufficient for uses... Fifty = all things of one part, and also as much as is sufficient; for fifty has a like signification to five.
The breadth fifty in fifty () = truth as much as is sufficient.
500 = much; and its tenth part, or fifty, = relatively somewhat, as is evident from .
